performance.measurement_notes: PP13 DSAPI test profile. GLM-5.2-FP8 has 78 main transformer layers. Keep non-production and profile-pinned until smoke and ds4-eval measurements are complete. The guarded vLLM 0.23.0 wheel overlay uses eager FLASHMLA_SPARSE attention with BF16 KV, Marlin FP8 MoE, an SM12 FlashMLA sparse validation shim, a chunked torch sparse-MLA BF16 fallback because upstream flash_mla_sparse_fwd rejects SM12, and a DS4 dense-last-window sparse indexer fallback on Spark GB10 because the upstream DeepGEMM fp8_fp4_mqa_logits indexer kernel rejects the architecture. FlashInfer sparse decode did not provide a clean GB10 path: XQA rejected GLM's 64 query heads, TRTLLM-GEN rejected the Spark architecture, and CUTE-DSL rejected sparse_mla_top_k. FP8 E4M3 KV produced corrupt repeated-token smoke outputs on GB10; LMCache HMA with BF16 KV loaded but hung direct OpenAI smoke requests before normal vLLM scheduler accounting.
